facts.text: The resort sits in a private bay on grounds that include a 10-million-year-old rainforest and beaches.
facts.excerpt: Set in a tranquil and private bay, on expansive grounds that are home to a 10-million-year-old rainforest and pristine beaches

facts.text: The resort's design is inspired by local architecture and indigenous art.
facts.excerpt: Built in harmony with the verdant surroundings and inspired by local architecture and indigenous art

facts.text: Philippe Villeroux of Tropical Area Architects designed the resort, which reflects local kampong village life.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Philippe Villeroux of Kuala Lumpur–based Tropical Area Architects, the resort reflects local kampong village life

facts.text: Mutiara Villa has three bedrooms, two private pools and access to its own private beach.
facts.excerpt: this spectacular villa boasts two private pools, access to its own private beach and three spacious bedrooms

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Spa has the island's only hammam facility.
facts.excerpt: including the island's only Hammam facility

facts.text: The spa has six overwater pavilions.
Guests receive complimentary breakfast during their stay.
facts.excerpt: Yes, complimentary breakfast is available at The Ritz-Carlton, Langkawi to hotel guests during their stay.

facts.text: The Ritz Kids program is built around four pillars: water, land, environmental responsibility and culture.
facts.excerpt: introducing them to the four important pillars of Ritz Kids discovery: Water, Land, Environmental Responsibility and Culture.

facts.text: The resort runs a sea cucumber nursery led by its marine biologist, where guests can take part hands-on.
facts.excerpt: Led by our marine biologist, the resort's sea cucumber nursery provides a hands-on experience

facts.text: The resort offers a private catamaran cruise aboard Dayang Mastura to secluded beaches and coves.
facts.excerpt: Set sail aboard Dayang Mastura, a private catamaran where refined cruising meets natural wonder.

facts.text: The SkyCab cable car and Temurun Waterfall are a 10-minute walk from the resort.
facts.excerpt: it’s only a 10-minute walk to the SkyCab cable car and Temurun Waterfall

facts.text: Guests must be at least 18 years old to have spa treatments.
facts.excerpt: Guests must be at least 18 years of age to enjoy spa treatments.

facts.text: The resort is large enough that golf cart service is offered to get around.
facts.excerpt: Even the golf cart service (crucial in a resort this big) is on point

facts.text: Monkeys live around the resort and can be mischievous up close.
facts.excerpt: The monkeys are adorable from a distance and mischievous up close.
